title: Classify Three Unclassified File Families In Taxonomy
description: Three file families are currently UNCLASSIFIED in 🔣️taxonomy.json (their leading emoji is in no fileKind): (A) 🎒️example.pack.semio (63 files, plus 🎒️example.bin sibling, ☁️example.las, 🗣️.dsl.semio nearby), (B) 🧪️fixture.json (63 files across ✏️s, 🧰️framework, 🌎️hub governed trees), (C) 🎯️<case-name>.json (~20 files under 🧪️fixtures dirs). Decide per family whether the remedy is registering a new fileKind (+ fileKindResolutionRules entry) or a registered semanticDirectoryKinds directory, following the 🛂️semio-descriptor and 📌️emptiness-marker precedents set this session. Repoint every reference repo-wide after any rename, then verify `bun 📜️script.ts verify taxonomy` still loads and run cargo check for any Rust-referenced fixtures.
summary: Classified all three unclassified file families in 🔣️taxonomy.json. Family A (🎒️.pack.semio + siblings): registered one new fileKind `semio-snapshot` (🎒️, .pack.semio) — the only genuinely missing registration across all three families; discovered .bin/.las/.ply/.zip were already registered under other emoji (💾️/🧊️/🗜️) and the on-disk files simply used the wrong emoji. Renamed 107 files to kind-only basenames and repointed 183 referencing files. Family B (🧪️fixture.json/🧪️schema.json): no registry change needed — `.fixture.json`/`.schema.json` were already registered (🔣️) and the existing `resident-fixture-member` semanticDirectoryKind already anticipates a `🧪️fixture/`or`🧪️schema/` directory holding a bare `🔣️.json` leaf (confirmed via 15 pre-existing precedent directories elsewhere in the repo). Moved 96 files into that directory shape and repointed 66 referencing files. Family C (🎯️<case-name>.json under 🧪️fixtures/): no registry change needed — the existing `fixture-case` semanticDirectoryKind (🧫️, open slug, parent `test-tube-fixtures`) is an exact structural match. Moved 30 files into `🧫️<case-name>/🔣️.json` (or `.schema.json`) and repointed 25 referencing files. Verified throughout with `loadCatalogTaxonomy()+validateTaxonomy()` (0 problems, both before/after, 84→86 fileKinds as the registry also received one unrelated concurrent addition), the `verify taxonomy` bare-CLI health bar (unchanged, healthy), and repo-wide `rg` sweeps confirming zero residual references to any of the 44 distinct old basenames across all three families. Ran `cargo check -p semio-s-plugin-architect --offline` (family C) to completion: 10626 pre-existing errors, all pre-existing async/non-suspending convention debt unrelated to this ticket — none reference the renamed fixture path or an include_str! failure. Full per-family reasoning, evidence, and the complete old→new path accounting are in 📓️summary.md.
